derivation: Matching official tokenizer: empty normalization sequence, byte-level BPE, no prefix-space insertion.
BPE merges cannot increase the count beyond original UTF-8 bytes. Twice the byte count is used conservatively.
Framing allowance: 1024 tokens per message plus 4096 fixed tokens. Tool calls, file IDs, remote image URLs and arbitrary parts are rejected.
Each inline image uses the documented 1024-token maximum. The bound never exceeds the documented full context ceiling.
Maximum configured output is reserved in full; cache discounts are not assumed. Actual usage is always settled.
Observed bound violations reject delivery and pause provider dispatch. Prior unknown reservations are never refunded or recomputed.
